title: Cervical tsDCS on Stroke Patients
official: Clinical and Neurophysiological Evaluation of the Effects of Cervical tsDCS on Stroke Patients With Distal Upper Limb Strength Deficit
summary: The present project aims to evaluate the facilitatory modulation of motor responses of the limb upper limb by tsDCS in patients with arm/hand hyposthenia after cerebral ischemia to verify the possible therapeutic benefits that this type of stimulation can induce in terms of of strength, dexterity and effectiveness in acts of daily living.
